topic: How to run a blameless post-mortem after an incident, so the team learns and fixes the system instead of blaming a person

request.audience: engineers, team leads and managers in product and operations teams who handle incidents
request.notes: Hand-drawn whiteboard look. Practical: viewers should be able to run their next post-mortem using a simple structure. Use a realistic but clearly invented incident as the running example. Avoid naming real companies or real outages. Evidence-based, no invented statistics.
